bestDays.headlineSummary: If you missed the 15 best days in the analysis period, your portfolio lost a large share of its value compared to staying fully invested.

missingBestQuarter.headline: Returns lost from missing the best quarter over the latest three-year window was ~5% annualized

volatility.headline: Low risk with 11.9% annualised volatility; typical daily move ±0.53%

summary.headline: 12 of 14 calendar years (86%) printed a new all-time high NAV — growth naturally spends much of its time at fresh peaks.

postAthReturns.headline: The average 1-year return from investing in Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth on an all-time high day is ~22%.

athDeclineOutlook.headline: In 79% of instances where Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth reached an all-time high, it never fell 10% below that level — further declines came from much higher levels.
